item.text: The worker now also marks its heartbeat stale during graceful shutdown, so `/health` can report it down immediately after SIGTERM; abrupt death still ages out naturally. I exercised the worker against a temporary SQLite database: normal completion, a two-failure retry completing on attempt three, and a three-failure job ending failed all produced the expected states.

item.text:
Implemented the SQLite-backed job API, worker with progress and retries, and polling browser UI.

`npm run build` and `git diff --check` pass. I verified worker completion and retry outcomes in a temporary database. I couldn’t run the HTTP checks here: the sandbox rejects local port binding with `listen EPERM`, so the server and check runner could not start. No worker process was left running.
